identification: Long narrow live-edge board, about 2 m by 25 cm, pale ochre ring-porous grain with fine rays; looks more like elm or ash than true walnut. Only one photo, chalked 1399 23/10/26. Gowans calls most of these 'walnut' loosely; the same sheds have sold purpleheart and macrocarpa under that title.

viewing_check: Look at the end grain and the pore pattern to confirm species (walnut has diffuse-semi-ring pores and chocolate heartwood; this looks like elm or ash). Check length, width, thickness, and for splits, bark, borer and wane. Measure it.
